summary: Verified iteration 4 features: (1) POST /api/inspire diet filters (vegetarian, vegan, gluten_free, low_carb, dairy_free, unknown-ignored) and (2) RecipeDetail scale toggle (1/2x, 1x, 2x) with no drift. Backend: 5/5 new diet tests passing. Frontend: diet chips, multi-select, clear button, localStorage persistence across reload, and scale toggle math on qty cells + yield pill all pass — 1x -> 2x -> 1x returns to identical original strings (zero drift across all 6 ingredient cells in tested recipe).

issues: Recipe hero image occasionally unrelated to the dish (e.g., 'Overnight Oats with Berries' rendered a street/cat photo). Pre-existing behavior of recipeImage/Unsplash fallback, not caused by this iteration but user-visible.

Units not pluralized after scaling — e.g., '1 cup (240ml)' x2 becomes '2 cup (480ml)' instead of '2 cups (480ml)'. Cosmetic only; the numeric spec examples in the task still match. Consider a simple unit-pluralization pass in scaleQuantity.

action_items: Optional: pluralize units in scaleQuantity when scaled value > 1 (cup -> cups, tablespoon -> tablespoons).
Optional (pre-existing): improve recipeImage() matching so inspire hero images better represent the dish.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py diet_map is complete and unknown ids are silently ignored via list-comprehension filter — safe.
Diet hint prompt uses 'AND' joined labels — good for hard-constraint framing; LLM compliance was 100% across 5 tests (veg+GF, vegan, low_carb, no-diet, unknown-diet).

scale.js: parseToken handles unicode fractions and mixed numbers correctly; formatNumber snaps to nearest clean fraction with 0.03 tolerance. Works well in practice. Minor: '1/2 tablespoon' when scaling from '1 tablespoon' x 0.5 is grammatically fine; but plural forms are not adjusted.
RecipeDetail: scale state is local (resets on remount / navigation) — expected behaviour, but users returning via Back may want persistence. Not required.
InspireMe cacheKey `category|sorted-diets` correctly separates cached results per diet combo; localStorage persistence for diets confirmed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Inspire diet chips + multi-select + clear + persistence + Scale toggle 1x/2x/half/no-drift)

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_inspire_diets.py at /app/backend/tests/ covers all diet flows (~2min because 4 LLM calls). Requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var when running pytest from /app (source frontend/.env or export). Frontend tests should always clear localStorage keys manifeast_inspire_cache and manifeast_inspire_diets before each Inspire test to avoid stale results. scale_2x renders '2 cup' (missing plural s) — that's expected behavior, not a bug per spec.
